svg.text: Does the whole candidate work better?
Fit from BF16 activations. Test the complete set of changes together.
Replay the entire model in BF16
Same current weights + recorded token contexts; bypass all low-precision projections.
Capture BF16 inputs, fit a set of candidate factors
Find outliers on fitting rows in authorized down_proj layers. Keep other settings.
Candidate = all fitted changes together, e.g. {L7: S_new, L20: S_new}
Compare final logits from three full-model paths
Same held-out token positions + full vocabulary. No new response sampling.
Compare logits relative L2 against Z_bf16
Whole set passes → review + publish | Fails → keep current recipe
Interactions are part of the test
Each replay produces its own downstream activations, through to the logits.
Lower sampled logits error does not establish better RL reward or convergence.
Implementation + CPU tests complete · Native GPU validation pending
S = SmoothQuant smoothing factors · L7/L20 = down_proj in those layers · Design diagrams
